name: Good Days and Bad Days
author: ahnmur
description:
How to:
🔊 Sound on! 
😀 Collect the Happy Days
⬆️ Keyboard UP arrow to jump
😟 Avoid the Sad Days 

Built with guidance from Unity's Create with Code Project 3. 
-I designed a custom background using Adobe Illustrator
-I modeled and texture painted the happy/sad coins in Blender
-I programmed a SpawnManager to spawn both Happy and Sad coins randomly and at different heights 
-I added collectible functionality + score counter for Happy Days 
-Custom sounds for jumping / Happy Days / Sad Days
